identity.title: [v0.92][WP-04.16b1.5] Extend authenticated Raft transport to governed learners

values.goal: Extend the secure #191 transport with one #201-authorized replication-only learner route and one shared durable pending-exclusion authority without weakening the exact voter cut or granting learner authority.
values.required_outcome: The unchanged authenticated voter cut may add at most one exact token-bound learner that can receive only canonical AppendEntries and InstallSnapshot traffic; pending exclusion is durably shared across #201 eligibility and ordinary sessions, while a separately governed rejoin may receive replication only.
declared_scope: Role-bound authenticated learner session and RPC allowlist
Ordinary-voter denial and exact replication-only rejoin exception
Reconnect, rotation, replay, bounds, restart, and path-safety proof
authority_boundary: The #191 voter cut remains exact and unchanged; learner admission never enters a voter configuration or quorum

Merged #201 exposes coarse AuthorityOperationKind::Membership authority plus byte-identical retained artifact bytes through a crate-private sealed accessor; EnrollNonVoting and RemoveVoter are canonical issue-local artifact discriminators, never #201 enum variants or values of an operation_kind field

Only a crate-private #202 adapter may consume the sealed #201 artifact, require the coarse Membership class, and validate exact canonical domain, bytes, digest, and issue-local discriminator before decoding any learner or exclusion field; no public accessor or generic artifact conversion is added

Only a durably published Membership operation whose exact artifact validates EnrollNonVoting can construct a learner admission, and only one whose exact artifact validates RemoveVoter can activate pending exclusion
The learner may receive AppendEntries and InstallSnapshot only and cannot vote, endorse, finalize, renew, mutate, act as Shepherd, or own/serve Observatory
A recovery learner requires a separate current operation, certificate, boot generation, operation namespace, and catch-up boundary

#202 remains unbound and edits no product source while #200 is active or unmerged; after #200 merges, #202 synchronizes to exact merged #200 ancestry and revalidates before binding because both issues own authority_protocol.rs, polis_runtime.rs, and distributed/mod.rs
Joint/final membership and promotion belong to #199; concrete stores belong to #200
operator_constraints: Do not bind or edit product source until PR #197 and #201 are externally reviewed, merged, and ancestral
Extend the existing transport authority; do not build a parallel Quinn/OpenRaft stack
Keep the issue bounded to learner/exclusion transport and narrow #201 eligibility consultation
Run fresh independent exact-head review before publication
Open a ready PR for visibility but never merge before operator review and authorization
No AWS use and no lifecycle closeout
